mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES mobility stops declining and turns up from its recent trough, weekday consumer trips should recover and lift RETAIL_REC within four weeks because commuting restores adjacent shopping and lunch traffic.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its prior four-week mean for the next 28 days even when WORKPLACES rises for two consecutive weekly observations.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in TRANSIT, especially after a week-on-week improvement of at least 3 points, should precede higher RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks because more station access expands discretionary shopping trips.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by at least 3 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase above its last-4-week average within 14 days after TRANSIT posts a week-on-week gain of 3 points or more.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while WORKPLACES stays depressed, shopping shifts toward local neighborhood purchases and retail visits fall over the next four weeks because people substitute home-based routines for discretionary outings.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above zero and WORKPLACES staying below zero in weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: An improvement in GROCERY_PHARM above its recent level signals broader errand traffic that spills into nearby retail visits within one week, so RETAIL_REC should move up over the next seven days when essential shopping intensity is high.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises above its prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 7 days of a weekly rise in GROCERY_PHARM.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS mobility rebounds sharply from a deep negative weekly level, leisure demand is returning and will spill into retail-and-recreation visits over the next two weeks, producing a higher RETAIL_REC path.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 5 points from the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls over the next 14 days after PARKS posts a weekly increase greater than 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both recover together, they indicate looser movement conditions that should raise RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks; the effect fails if one series rises while the other remains weak.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its last-4-week mean within 28 days when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve together for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed drop in TRANSIT after it has been recovering is a proxy for tighter mobility controls, and retail visits should fall within two weeks because discretionary trips are immediately constrained.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls after a prior two-week rise
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises within 14 days even though TRANSIT reverses downward after a two-week recovery.

mechanism_narrative: In a holiday or weekend-heavy regime, elevated PARKS together with elevated GROCERY_PHARM indicates mixed leisure-and-errand activity that should support a modest retail lift over four weeks; the effect weakens when only one of the two series is high.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to outperform its prior four-week average over the next 28 days when both PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM stay elevated.
